Finding your own off switch

Creating a small separation between work and the rest of your day.

Everyday wellbeing7 Oct 2026

When work happens in the same place as everything else, the end of the day can feel less obvious. A small routine can help mark the transition.

Choose a closing moment Write down where you will begin tomorrow, put your work things away, or close the door to your workspace. Pick something that suits your circumstances.

Make room for what comes next You might change clothes, step outside, or make a meal. It does not need to be a productive routine. It only needs to feel like a different part of your day.

From the Stillwell concept journal. Sample editorial content for this website preview, not personal clinical guidance.
